sources.title: Metapatterns lens (one-author synthesis, non-canonical)
sources.citation: "Architectural Metapatterns" / "Introduction to Software Architecture With Actors" (Denys Poltorak)

claims.statement: The "microkernel regarded as multiple ports-and-adapters cores sharing a common middleware", "middleware-gateway", and "distributed microkernel relates to mesh" framings: recorded explicitly as one author's non-canonical synthesis, with caveats (OS-vs-pattern conflation; gateway is a sub-type of middleware; a service mesh is a networking data plane and does not virtualize system resources). Single-author, self-published CC catalogue, not standard CS doctrine.
